drafts.text:
Google updated its spam policies to warn sites that let users publish "shareable pages, generated outputs, or interactive tools." (h/t @lilyraynyc)

For a local business site the safe play hasn't changed. Pages you wrote, about jobs you actually did, in towns you actually serve.
drafts.video_tip: Video tip (@BourgAnthony, about 15 sec, vertical screen recording): type site:[client domain] into Google and show how many pages come up, then show the site's own page list or sitemap side by side. Caption: 'Is Google even seeing all your pages?' Only show the real counts you get; don't add a number that isn't on screen.
drafts.best_time_ct: Weekday late morning CT; the standing 8:54 AM slot works for one a day.

E-E-A-T isn't just an AI search thing. As @CyrusShepard put it, it influences rankings too.

For a trade business that means the owner's name, the license number, real job photos, and reviews you didn't write. Same work helps you on Google and in ChatGPT.
